turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Fernhollow Solar, this is Ansel. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, my name is Marisol Venn. I'd like a quote for solar panels and a battery for my house in Quillhaven.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Happy to help, Marisol. Can you tell me a bit about the roof?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's the back roof, the one over the garden. Slate tiles, and it was redone two years ago, so it's in good shape.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That helps. Do you know roughly how much electricity you use in a year?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Not off the top of my head. I can send you my statement from the power co-op later this week.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect. Is the best number to reach you the one you're calling from?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, but please don't ring in the mornings. I'm on the early shift at Dunmere Bakery and I'm not home until about one.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Understood, afternoons only. Anything else we should plan around?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: One thing. My sister is handing down her electric car to me in November, so I suppose I'll be using more power from then on.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good to know. I'll put together a starting quote for a 4 kilowatt array and a 5 kilowatt-hour battery, and we can adjust once I've seen the statement.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sounds good. Oh, and I have a dog, Biscuit. He's nervous around strangers, so I'd need some warning before anyone visits.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No problem, we'll always message before a visit. You'll have the quote by Wednesday 16 September.
